versions.changelog:
- Major release introducing the VEE Qwen Transcendent Nexus V91 architecture.
- Qwen becomes the primary intelligence/model provider for all reasoning, coding, multimodal, and agent tasks; other providers are now optional, never required.
- System emphasizes provider/model independence with plug-and-play adapter support and no permanent external dependencies.
- Core operational loop now expanded for autonomous capability discovery, benchmarking, evolution, and sandboxed self-improvement.
- Strict boundaries ensure secure, auditable self-modification, human-in-the-loop approval for critical actions, and rigorous model/code verification.
- Evolution policy mandates only promoting upgrades (models, tools, workflows) based on benchmark-driven, objective improvement.
